summary: Does the gloss räuchern belong to šmš?
rationale: The only example has šamóšo-yo, translated Kirchensänger in both the entry and 11/220. The supplied dictionary independently defines šamošo as Diakon, Kirchensänger and links it to √šmš; the entry head gives to serve; to perform a function. None of this evidence demonstrates burning incense. Since the example is nominal and cannot by itself establish the finite verb’s full meaning, verify the existing gloss rather than substituting a new sense without evidence.
